rejectionNotes: Each entry is [prefix, fragment-of-the-refusal-or-null]. The fragment names WHICH rule fires, not the whole sentence, because the client expands two of the server's messages for the admin reading them. Entries matching several rules ('/', '/acme//x/') are what pin the shared check ORDER.

serverOnlyRules.leading-or-trailing-whitespace: The client trims before validating, since the trimmed value is what it sends, so this rule cannot fire there.
serverOnlyRules.prefix-length-in-bytes: A 512-byte bound the client does not restate; a prefix that long is already inert and the server refuses it with a message naming the limit.
serverOnlyRules.empty-prefix: The server refuses an empty prefix; the client returns null for it so an untouched field shows no error. Save stays disabled on empty regardless.
